RAF pellet gun use suspended amid Delhi protests; CRPF deployed

The Rapid Action Force (RAF) has been barred from using pellet guns until further orders, following protests in Delhi. Sixteen additional companies of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) will be deployed in the city. The Director General of CRPF stated that a post-analysis of RAF actions during the protests will be conducted. Forty-seven RAF personnel sustained injuries during these actions.
